verdict.rationale: Stripe explicitly documents an 'Issuing for agents' capability by name: virtual cards scoped to a single task/session that auto-invalidate after use, combined with spending controls (merchant category/ID/country/amount caps) and real-time synchronous authorization webhooks to approve/decline in policy — exactly matching the story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on third-party validation specifically of the agent-issuing feature (community evidence found only covers general Issuing product experience, not the agent-specific flow) and clear public customer case studies of AI agents using it.
